cohort: The study included pre-eclamptic women, predominantly with preterm and/or severe pre-eclampsia, who were recruited as part of an ongoing cohort and completed at least 3 months of postpartum follow-up.
finding: Advancing maternal age, multiparity, and eclampsia were found to significantly increase the risk of new-onset postpartum chronic hypertension (PPCH) at 3 months postpartum.
